places.name: Zytglogge Clock Tower
places.ai_summary: A medieval clock tower in the heart of Bern, featuring an astronomical clock and a fascinating history.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available at specific times.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the clock’s mechanism.

places.name: Federal Palace (Bundeshaus)
places.ai_summary: The seat of the Swiss Federal Assembly and Federal Council, showcasing impressive architecture and political history.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted during parliamentary sessions.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for guided tours in English.

places.name: Old Town (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: The historic old town of Bern, a UNESCO World Heritage site, with medieval architecture and charming streets.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot; many shops and cafes have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Bear Park and the Rose Garden nearby.

places.name: Bern Cathedral (Münster)
places.ai_summary: The tallest cathedral in Switzerland, known for its stunning Gothic architecture and panoramic views from the tower.

opening_hours.notes: Tower access may close earlier; check in advance.

places.best_time_to_visit: Morning for sunrise views, late afternoon for sunset
places.place_tip: Climb the tower for breathtaking views of the city and Alps.

places.name: Rosengarten Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A beautiful rose garden offering a panoramic view of Bern’s old town and the Aare river.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is during the blooming season (April to October).

places.place_tip: Visit in spring to see the roses in full bloom.

places.ai_summary: A park and zoo in Bern, home to the city’s symbol, the Bernese bears. Offers a natural habitat and viewing area.

opening_hours.notes: Bears are usually active in the late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Watch the bears from the viewing platform; they are fed around 4 PM.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in summer for swimming and picnicking.

places.place_tip: Bring a swimsuit and enjoy a swim in the Aare!

places.place_tip: Try the local Swiss dishes and enjoy the historic ambiance.

places.name: Nydegg Bridge & Matte Quarter
places.ai_summary: A historic bridge and the charming Matte quarter in Bern, known for its wooden houses and artisan shops.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot; many shops have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the artisan shops and enjoy the view of the Aare river.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the dinosaur skeletons and the interactive exhibits.

places.place_tip: Visit on a Tuesday or Saturday for the full market experience.

places.place_tip: Explore the extensive collection of artifacts and the special exhibits on Einstein.

places.place_tip: Visit on a match day for a lively atmosphere around the stadium.
